nodes.label: onnx_parser
nodes.desc: Reads an ONNX ModelProto, walks the graph node by node, and emits MIGraphX instructions; handles opsets, initializers, and subgraphs.

nodes.label: op_parser registry
nodes.desc: Registry that maps each ONNX op name to its parse_* handler from the parse_attention.cpp / parse_convolution.cpp family.

nodes.label: module
nodes.desc: The graph unit: a list of instructions with named parameters; sub-modules represent loops, branches, and fused regions.

nodes.label: program
nodes.desc: Owns the module tree, drives compile() through target passes, and eval() executes the result on device memory.

nodes.label: pass_manager
nodes.desc: run_passes iterates passes over every module, tracing each stage and running dead-code elimination between steps.

nodes.label: target registry
nodes.desc: Global name-to-target map; lookup_target resolves 'gpu', 'cpu', or 'ref' for program::compile.

nodes.label: gpu target
nodes.desc: Assembles the five-stage AMD GPU pass list (dynamic shapes, required, optimize/rewrite, fusion, backend) conditioned on the gfx generation.

nodes.label: compile_ops
nodes.desc: Codegen stage: picks HipRTC, code-object, or precompiled routes per op, manages tuning plans and the compile cache.

nodes.label: cpu lowering
nodes.desc: CPU target pass that maps generic ops onto native C++ implementations or oneDNN primitives.

nodes.label: ref target
nodes.desc: Slow but portable reference implementation used by the driver's verify command to check other targets.

nodes.label: load_save
nodes.desc: Serializes a compiled program into the MXR container format and reads it back without recompiling.

nodes.label: migraphx-driver
nodes.desc: CLI with run/perf/verify/trim subcommands; perf benchmarks compiled programs and verify diffs against the ref target.
